description.value: Sylvia's Harlem is a legendary soul food restaurant in Harlem. It is a soul food restaurant located at 328 Malcolm X Boulevard, between 126th and 127th Streets. It was founded in 1962 by Sylvia Woods, and Sunday gospel brunch is the classic visit.
